Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer failed to appropriately identify and distinguish between multiple films with the title "Lo Zappatore" in its initial search. It incorrectly concluded that the 1950 release was the only relevant film for comparison, disregarding the 1980 film titled "Zappatore." While the task explicitly required finding the release year of "Lo Zappatore," the WebSurfer agent should have flagged the existence of multiple films with related titles and gathered information on both, especially since the 1980 version is titled "Zappatore" but is often referred to as "Lo Zappatore" informally. This oversight led to the failure to consider the more recent 1980 film in the final comparison, which would have affected the correctness of the solution to the real-world problem.
